name: Tartaglia
notes: KQM and Game8 agree on 4pc Nymph's Dream (KQM: about 3% better than the others without prestacking), ATK% Sands, Hydro DMG Goblet and a CRIT Circlet; Heart of Depth is the second set in both (Game8's third, Night of the Sky's Unveiling, is Game8's alone). Weapons: Game8 puts Polar Star first; KQM lists five 5-star CRIT bows with no order (Aqua Simulacra first for burst-focused builds, Polar Star for prestacking), so Polar Star leads and the others follow. Talent order differs: KQM is Normal Attack > Burst > Skill (Bow Focus; Melee Focus is Skill first), Game8 is Skill > Burst > Normal. The card uses KQM's Bow Focus order because the damage is in the Normal and Charged Attacks. The damage line is a Normal Attack (Aimed Shot 43.9% to 86.7%, ratio 1.975), so the table is physical, though the damage is Hydro; the fully charged shot is on the elemental curve. Goals are Game8's: ATK 1,800-2,100, CR 70-80, CD 180 or above, ER 110-130 (upper ends). KQM gives no goals or ER. Partners are inferred (Pyro and Anemo for Vaporize with Kazuha, Electro for Electro-Charged); the sources give no team list.
